newsitem.title: USA: CIBCR leading inflation index 105.1 in February.
newsitem.headline: CIBCR leading inflation index 105.1 in February.

text.p: A spokesman at The Center for International Business Cycle Research (CIBCR) said its leading inflation index (LII) rose to 105.1 in February from a revised 104.5 in January.

Rises in the number of purchasing managers reporting higher buying prices and an increase in the smoothed growth rate of the LII helped push the index higher, the CIBCR report said. But the ratio of civilian employment to working-age population slipped to 63.5 percent from 63.6 percent between January and February, it said.
"The tentative prediction from these numbers is that inflation will remain under control or at most pick up a bit in the near future," said the CIBCR report.
